 SBI Clerk rrelims result 2026 out; access mains hall ticket; exam on Nov 26, 27
 Soumi Roy | November 18, 2026 | 08:28 PM IST | 2 mins read
 The State Bank of India has announced the SBI Clerk preliminary examination result for the Junior Associate recruitment for 7,680 vacancies.

 Subscribe SBI conducts the SBI Clerk exams to select candidates for Junior Associate posts. (Representative Image: Magnific) The State Bank of India (SBI) has declared the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 for the Junior Associate (Customer Support and Sales) recruitment examination. Candidates who appeared for the SBI Clerk Prelims exam 2026 can check their qualifying status on the official website, sbi.bank.in. SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 LIVE Updates  
 Those who have been shortlisted for the SBI clerk mains 2026 exam can download the hall ticket made available on the official website. SBI clerk mains 2026 exam will be held on November 26 and 27. 
 SBI conducted the Junior Associate preliminary examination on September 26 and 27, 2026. Candidates who qualify in the prelims will be shortlisted for the SBI Mains examination, the next stage of the recruitment process. SBI will also release the category-wise SBI Clerk Prelims cut-off 2026 along with the prelims scorecard.
 The SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 is available in PDF format and contains the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the Mains exam. Candidates can also check their individual scorecards and category-wise cut-off marks through the SBI Careers portal.
 Also read Where are the bank jobs? Finance still hiring, just not where commerce graduates are looking 
 Steps to check SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to check the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026:
 Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
 Navigate to the ‘Careers’ section.
 Click on ‘Current Openings’.
 Find the Junior Associate recruitment notification, Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
 Click on the SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026 link.
 Download the result PDF and search for your roll number.
 To download the individual scorecard, candidates will need to log in using their registration number and password or date of birth.
 Also read IBPS RRB PO admit card 2026 out at ibps.in; exam on November 21, 22 
 What after SBI Clerk prelims scorecard 2026?
 Candidates shortlisted in the preliminary examination will move to the Mains stage. The next steps in the recruitment process include:
 Qualified candidates will appear for the Mains exam, tentatively scheduled for November 26, 2026.
 Candidates' performance in the Mains examination will determine their merit position.
 Candidates who have not studied the specified local language in Class 10 or 12 may have to appear for a Local Language Proficiency Test
 Final selection: Selection will be based on performance in the Mains examination, subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility and language requirements.
 Candidates will have to regularly visit the official SBI website for more updates on the SBI Mains examination.
